info.title: SERK QUORUM API
info.description: Session cookie authentication. State-changing requests require the `x-csrf-token` header from GET /auth/session. Every response carries `x-request-id`. Breaking changes require a new major path (/api/v2).

Outcome: working | live_disabled | not_configured | key_rejected | model_or_endpoint_not_found | request_rejected | rate_limited | provider_error | timeout | unreachable.
